import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, cap, next;
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[200005];
    static int cnt = 0;
    static int[] head = new int[505];
    static int[] p = new int[505];
    static int[] v = new int[505];
    static int[] dep = new int[505];
    static int s = 501, t = 502, ans = 0, n, m;

    static void add(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[++cnt] = new Edge();
        edges[cnt].u = u;
        edges[cnt].v = v;
        edges[cnt].flow = 0;
        edges[cnt].cap = w;
        edges[cnt].next = head[u];
        head[u] = cnt;
        edges[++cnt] = new Edge();
        edges[cnt].u = v;
        edges[cnt].v = u;
        edges[cnt].flow = 0;
        edges[cnt].cap = 0;
        edges[cnt].next = head[v];
        head[v] = cnt;
    }

    static boolean find() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            v[i] = dep[i] = 0;
        }
        q.add(s);
        v[s] = 1;
        dep[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                if (v[edges[i].v] == 0 && edges[i].flow < edges[i].cap) {
                    p[edges[i].v] = i;
                    q.add(edges[i].v);
                    v[edges[i].v] = 1;
                    dep[edges[i].v] = dep[x] + 1;
                    if (edges[i].v == t) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs(int x, int now) {
        if (x == t || now == 0) {
            return now;
        }
        int t = now;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            if (edges[i].cap > edges[i].flow && dep[edges[i].v] == dep[x] + 1) {
                int delta = dfs(edges[i].v, Math.min(t, edges[i].cap - edges[i].flow));
                if (delta == 0) {
                    dep[edges[i].v] = 0;
                }
                edges[i].flow += delta;
                edges[(i - 1) ^ 1].flow -= delta;
                t -= delta;
                if (t == 0) {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return now - t;
    }

    static void dinic() {
        while (find()) {
            ans += dfs(s, 1000000007);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {

        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] input = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(input[0]);
        m = Integer.parseInt(input[1]);
        char[][] a = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        char[][] b = new char[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            input = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = input[j - 1].charAt(0);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    int[][] dis = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                            dis[k][l] = 10000;
                        }
                    }
                    dis[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] p = q.poll();
                        int x = p[0], y = p[1];
                        for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                            int nx = x + (-1 + f * 2), ny = y + (-1 + f * 2);
                            if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] < '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1) {
                                dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;
                                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                        for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                            if (dis[k][l] <= Math.min(m, dis[k][l])) {
                                add((i - 1) * n + j, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    add(s, (i - 1) * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] > '9') {
                    continue;
                }
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int l = 1; l <= n; l++) {
                        int[][] dis = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
                        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {

                        q.add(new int[]{i, j});

                            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
                            for (int f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
                                int nx = x + (-1 + f * 2), ny = y + (-1 + f * 2);
                                if (nx > 0 && ny > 0 && nx <= n && ny <= n && a[nx][ny] < '9' && dis[nx][ny] > dis[x][y] + 1 && dis[x][y] < dis[i][j]) {
                                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[x][y] + 1;

                                if (dis[k][l] <= Math.min(m, dis[k][l])) {
                                    add((i - 1) * n + j + 100, (k - 1) * n + l + 100, 10000);

            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                input = br.readLine().split(" ");
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    b[i][j] = input[k - 1].charAt(0);
                    if (b[i][j] < '9') {
                        add((i - 1) * n + j + 100, t, b[i][j] - '0');
